premises.text: Heavy industry needs heat that is simultaneously cheap, reliable, and flame-hot, which zero-carbon options today cannot deliver affordably
premises.evidence_span: There is no affordable way to decarbonize our heavy industries

premises.text: A thermal battery can store cheap renewable or off-peak electricity as on-demand industrial heat delivered as hot gas
premises.evidence_span: takes in electricity from renewables or off-peak nuclear or hydro whenever it's cheap, whenever it's abundant, whenever it's available

premises.text: The system reaches ~1,800 Celsius heat while remaining at least three times cheaper than hydrogen
premises.evidence_span: we can keep it affordable, at least three times cheaper than hydrogen

premises.text: The battery retrofits existing furnaces, boilers, and kilns by piping in hot gas without radically changing the process
premises.evidence_span: We can attach to your existing process, pipe in our hot gas to your furnace, your boiler, even your turbine

premises.text: Semiconductor-doped electrically conductive fire bricks enable hotter, longer-lasting electric heating than existing heaters
premises.evidence_span: We use semiconductor doping to make them electrically conductive

premises.text: Stacked e-bricks form a three-in-one heater, thermal store, and heat exchanger from cheap abundant refractory materials
premises.evidence_span: It's a giant electric heater. It's a giant thermal store. And it's a giant heat exchanger that gets the energy out, all built from cheap, affordable, abundant bricks

premises.text: In high-renewable regions the system can pay back in about five years while offsetting most site carbon, or beat electric boilers on time-of-use rates
premises.evidence_span: We can pay back in five years while offsetting 80% of your carbon emissions
